front.note: White pencil cup and notebook sit on the wood tray; staggered pencils now have pointed tips.

rear.note: Rear cup wall stays round and the notebook remains seated on the tray.

detail.note: The cup has a rolled lip, visible interior and closed floor; pencil tips show exposed wood and colored lead.

underside.note: Wood tray underside remains closed and its original footprint is unchanged.

clay.note: Clay confirms a smooth open cup and distinct sharpened pencil silhouettes.
